tests.name: safe_public_evidence_path_never_escapes_public_dir
tests.rationale: The public evidence mapper must turn arbitrary relative Path parts into a safe path under the public evidence directory.
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from enoch_control_plane.control_plane.paper_writer import EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_DIR, _safe_public_evidence_path

part = st.text(min_size=0, max_size=20)
@given(st.lists(part, min_size=0, max_size=6))
def test_safe_public_evidence_path_never_escapes_public_dir(parts):
    rel_path = Path(*parts) if parts else Path('')
    result = Path(_safe_public_evidence_path(rel_path))
    assert not result.is_absolute()
    assert result.parts[0] == EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_DIR
    assert '..' not in result.parts
    assert all(p and p not in {'.', '..'} for p in result.parts)

tests.name: claim_evidence_matches_is_bounded_and_sorted
tests.rationale: Claim-to-evidence matching feeds the claim ledger, so it must return bounded, sorted, normalized match records for arbitrary text.
tests.code:
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from enoch_control_plane.control_plane.paper_writer import _claim_evidence_matches

file_strategy = st.fixed_dictionaries({'path': st.text(max_size=20), 'source_path': st.text(max_size=20), 'sha256': st.text(max_size=20), 'content': st.text(max_size=200)})
@given(st.text(max_size=200), st.lists(file_strategy, max_size=8))
def test_claim_evidence_matches_is_bounded_and_sorted(claim, public_files):
    refs = _claim_evidence_matches(claim, public_files)
    assert len(refs) <= (3 if any(float(r.get('match_score') or 0) > 0 for r in refs) else 2)
    scores = [float(r.get('match_score') or 0) for r in refs]
    assert all(0.0 <= s <= 1.0 for s in scores)
    positives = [s for s in scores if s > 0]
    assert positives == sorted(positives, reverse=True)
    for ref in refs:
        assert {'path', 'source_path', 'sha256', 'match_score', 'quote'} <= set(ref)
